text.tspan: Every API request first gets a request id, security headers, an origin check (CSRF) and JSON and cookie parsing. Then the route's rate limit, session and role checks run.
[created, changed, or no stored document yet]
one failing project is logged and does not stop the run
a TOR that only has an invitation PDF gets no fairness flags
[until the call limit is reached or the queue is empty]
A3. After enrichment: refresh the TORs just enriched, then notify vendors
[the TOR has an invitation with a file]
A4. Lifecycle job (daily at 02:30 Bangkok time)
B. Visitor: browse, read, download, report (no account needed)
a signed-in vendor's hidden TORs are left out
C1. Sign up and sign in with a password
[wrong code or the pending step expired]
[state mismatch, exchange failed, or email not verified]
[user exists and is not on cooldown]
[invalid or expired link, or weak password]
C4. Account settings that need a recent re-authentication
D. Vendor workspace (needs a vendor session)
E1. Admin sign-in and the 2FA gate
[the top bar asks on a timer]
E5. Run the pipeline by hand
[the ingestion page asks while a run is going]
E6. Capture projects with the Chrome extension
E7. Chat, help content, settings, logs and sessions

svg.text: search software projects page by page, fetch details (polite, rate limited)
upsert Tor by projectCode, compare sourceContentHash
inspect the PDF (digital, scanned, unreadable, missing)
store the PDF (binaries never go in Mongo)
close the run (success, partial or failed) with counts, write SystemLog
read the fairness pre-filter thresholds (or the defaults)
claim the next job under a lease (first claim creates the run)
validate the result against the schema
pick category and project type, fix Buddhist-era dates
drop fairness signals below the thresholds, attach data points and confidence
save aiSummary, fairnessFlags, scalar fields, pipelineStatus = enriched
retry later with backoff, mark failed after the last attempt
read procurement stage (national e-GP first, BMA portal second)
small call: read the bid deadline
write stage and deadline (checks lastCheckedAt first)
score each vendor profile against the new TORs, notify at 70 or more
replay every saved search that has alerts on
create Notification rows (profile match, saved search match), never twice
one digest email per vendor, unless the vendor turned email alerts off
pick enriched, unfinished TORs, oldest checked first
read deadline only for a new invitation or a changed file
write procurement fields only, never the AI queue
mark runs with no progress as failed (all four phases)
create an AdminNotification for every admin
open the home or search page
GET /api/tors (keyword, agency, category, budget, deadline, status, sort)
group by category or agency, percentiles of reference price
TOR without internal fields or admin-only flag details
AI summary, fairness signals with confidence, status, similar TORs
POST /api/tors/:id/report (rate limited, optional email if anonymous)
POST /api/auth/login (limited per IP and per account)
find the user and compare the hash
store a one-time pending id on the user
200 mfaRequired and a short-lived pending cookie
POST /api/auth/mfa/verify (6-digit code or a recovery code)
check pending cookie, current 30 s step, step not used before
redirect to Google (state, PKCE challenge and nonce kept in a cookie)
redirect to /api/auth/google/callback with code and state
exchange the code and verify the identity
find the user by Google id, else by email (link), else create a vendor
redirect to /login/verify with the pending cookie
redirect to the dashboard (new users go to profile onboarding)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password (limited per IP and per account)
store the hash of a random token with an expiry
send the reset link (token in the URL fragment)
200 (the same answer whether or not the email exists)
check the token hash (constant time), expiry and password rules
set the password, bump tokenVersion, delete every session
200 (no sign-in, the user must sign in again)
PUT /api/auth/password, PUT /api/auth/email, DELETE /api/auth/me, 2FA setup or off, logout-others, revoke a session
POST /api/auth/reauth (password, plus a code if 2FA is on)
seed and QR code, then recovery codes
GET /api/auth/reports (my own reports and their resolution)
read the profile and open TORs, skipping hidden ones
compute the match score for each TOR and sort
add or remove the TOR in the hidden list
upsert the bookmark (capped), status interested, preparing, submitted or missed
store the filters and the alerts on or off switch
read or save the calendar note
read the notifications and the unread count
start or continue the chat thread, append the message
sign in (password or Google, then the 2FA code)
log every change to the application log (who, route, outcome, field names)
count TORs today, open flags, latest runs, 30-day run history
aggregate published TORs with their flags and the flagged count
read the TOR, reasoning and data points
PATCH /api/admin/tors/:id (fields, bid deadline, resolveFlags, resolveReports, note)
update the TOR, acknowledge flags, resolve its open reports
read reports with reporter and TOR
PATCH /api/admin/reports/:id (resolve with a note, or reopen)
crawl in the background, same code as A1
save TORs, queue AI jobs, close the run
same enrichment as A2, then A3
pick projects on the national e-GP search page
read the project and its document bundle
store the TOR PDF (the invitation PDF if there is no TOR yet)
upsert Tor, queue AI jobs (the keyword gate runs on the title)
how many captured TORs have no stored document
GET /api/admin/chats, its messages, POST a reply, mark read, PATCH the status
the vendor sees the reply on the next poll
store the thresholds (used from the next enrichment run)
GET /api/admin/users, POST revoke a user's sessions or everyone's
